name: amberxvid-settings
description: Read or write AmberX Vid's settings (namespace amberxvid-settings).

action.description: read every row, or write one.

key.description: ringAlerts — Ring out loud (switch); ringVolume — Ring volume (number); trayAlerts — Tray alerts (switch); followedLiveAlerts — Alert me when somebody I follow goes live (switch); defaultPostVisibility — Default post visibility (select); defaultAlbumVisibility — Default album visibility (select); whoMayCall — Who may call me (select); whoMayInvite — Who may invite me (select); cameraId — Camera (text); micId — Microphone (text); callResolution — Call resolution (select); uplinkCapKbps — Uplink cap (number); messengerEnterToSend — Enter sends the message (switch); autoplayPreviews — Autoplay stream previews (switch); viewerRecordFormat — Viewer recording format (select); recorderResolution — Recorder resolution (select); recorderQuality — Recorder quality (select); animationIntensity — Animation intensity (select); backgroundArmed — Arm background recording (switch)

value.description: The new value when writing; matches the row's declared kind.
